summary: It is a generator of the standard data: x_j ∈ integralAfter(δ, places above p).

steps.claim: translateDatum(x, j) = finHeisOp(x_j)θ° is a generator of Std_δ once x_j ∈ integralAfter(δ, above p): by `mem_integralAfter`, since places above p do not contain levelNorm(ϑ)·N (p prime to it, p ≠ N) and either δ = π_G or p ∤ g₀g₁ (so w̄ is not chosen).
steps.lean:

  (H.support_subset x hx) fun w _ ↦ by simp_all [← piGBar_mul_star, IsChosen,
  ← w.natCast_mem_iff_dvd, w.2.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem, D.notMem_piPlaces_of_ne hp,
  or_and_left, -Nat.cast_prod, w.2.notMem_of_isCoprime_of_mem hQ.cast], rfl⟩
